data.title: 柴郡 · 枫林小径的红叶暖意
data.description: 铺满红枫金杏的公园石子路上，秋风轻拂卷起落叶。柴郡身穿露背毛衣外搭一条格子围巾，小手紧紧挽着身旁人的臂弯不愿松开。她仰头注视着飘落的绯红枫叶，毛茸茸的猫耳顺从地靠在指挥官肩头，整个人如同一只黏人又温顺的小猫，散发着甜美的秋日恋爱芬芳。
data.location: 枫树与银杏交织的公园林荫小路
data.action: 小鸟依人挽着对方胳膊散步，猫耳贴向肩膀，眼神柔情似水
data.lighting: 斜阳穿透金红枫叶树冠形成的浓郁暖色丁达尔束光
data.camera: medium shot, couple perspective, walking side by side
data.promptProse: Under the falling maple leaves, Cheshire slips an arm around the Commander's elbow and nestles her cat ears near their shoulder. Her blue-gray twintails spill over her plaid scarf. Beside her, the short auburn-haired Commander wears a solid olive field coat. They walk along the gravel path beneath the late sun.
data.animaCaption: Cheshire looks up at the falling leaves, her long blue-gray twintails, cat ears and plaid scarf framing her face. The Commander, with short auburn hair and an olive field coat, walks beside her as she loops her arm through theirs.
